card.name: Weekly dosing interval words
card.fires_on: The time unit ending a dosing-frequency phrase, mostly "weeks" or "weekly" after "every two" or "once", in dose instructions for injected or infused drugs.

modes.label: Dosing interval unit
modes.description: The word weeks, week or weekly closing a phrase such as "every two weeks" in dosage text.
